2026_01_ATL_PIT.headline: Atlanta’s emergency quarterback plan runs straight into Pittsburgh’s edge pressure
2026_01_ATL_PIT.paragraph1: Atlanta will open with Cooper Rush because Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix Jr. are both out, making Bijan Robinson and protection discipline even more important against Pittsburgh’s edge group. The Steelers can compress the game with T.J. Watt, Alex Highsmith and Nick Herbig attacking a Falcons offense that is still installing Kevin Stefanski’s system. Atlanta’s clearest path is to keep Rush out of long-yardage situations, while Pittsburgh must avoid letting Robinson turn checkdowns and early-down carries into sustained drives.
2026_01_ATL_PIT.model_rationale: Pittsburgh’s pressure structure can make Atlanta’s quarterback limitations more costly, while the Falcons need Robinson and manageable downs to keep the Steelers from dictating the game.
